proves.claim: With gate.gateAgedMinutes 2 set in machine settings, over the claim action a gate job offered 3 minutes before the claim is handed to a runner holding a test job ahead of fresh shards.

api.jobs.claims-gate-aged-minutes-settin.why: Without this test the claim action ignores the setting and a gate job waits the fixed 5 minutes behind a shard backlog.

proves.claim: With gate.gateAgedMinutes unset the same 3-minute-old gate job stays behind the shards over the claim action.

api.jobs.claims-gate-aged-minutes-unset.why: Without this test a changed default would move every gate job ahead of shards unnoticed.
